items.title: 13.3.2 Types of Animals on the basis ability of Thermoregulation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of poikilotherms and homeotherms (PDF 8).

items: Poikilotherms apna darja-e-hararat tang had mein nahi rakh sakte; yeh bohat badalta aur aam taur par mahol ke barabar hota hai. Kitab tamam invertebrates aur machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles ginwati hai.

Homeotherms mahol se qata-e-nazar kafi mustaqil andaruni darja-e-hararat rakhte hain, 'thermostat' yaani hypothalamus se thandak ya garmi ka amal shuru kar ke. Mammals aur parinde homeotherms hain; insaan bohat thande ya garam mahol mein bhi taqreeban 37 C rakhte hain.

blocks.text: Poikilotherms ko mustaqil darja-e-hararat ke liye bohat zyada khana nahi chahiye, to woh aisi ghizai kami wali jagahon mein zinda reh sakte hain jahan homeotherm bhooka mar jaye.

blocks.prompt: Homeotherms aur poikilotherms mein farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Homeotherms taqreeban mustaqil darja-e-hararat rakhte (parinde, mammals) magar bohat khana chahte hain; poikilotherms darja-e-hararat mahol ke saath badalne dete (machhliyan, reptiles) aur kahin kam khana chahte hain.

items: Poikilotherms: badalta darja-e-hararat, kam khana. Homeotherms: hypothalamus se mustaqil darja-e-hararat.
